text.description_html:
AHI SIG505, Black Industrial Barn Door System

This 78 Inch Barn Door Kit comes with everything you need to install a sliding door up to 3 feet in width and weighing up to 200 pounds. The Industrial Chic 6-1/2 Foot Barn Door Kit has a timeless, black finish that makes the movie reel style really stand out. All the parts and accessories are made from solid metal for long-lasting durability.

Features of the Rustic Sliding Barn Door Installation Kit:

  • Comes with all necessary hardware to install wood barn door.
  • All steel construction.
  • Nylon covered wheel for silent operation.
  • Ball bering wheel for a long lasting, smooth operation.
  • Anti-jump wall mounting brackets.
  • The track-mounted door stops have rubber bumpers so they will not damage the doors.

Specifications of the SIG505 78 Inch Barn Door Kit:

  • Finish: Black
  • Material: Steel
  • Track: 78" (6-1/2 feet)
  • For doors up to 36" (3 feet)
  • For wood doors up to 200 LBS.
  • AHI SIG505 Specifications Diagram (PDF)

Package Includes:

  • 1 78" Track
  • 2 Wheel Sets
  • 2 Track End Caps
  • 1 Floor Mounted Door Guide
  • 5 Wall Mounts
  • 2 Stoppers
  • All necessary installation hardware.

In case of a doorway larger than 3 feet, custom length tracks up are available. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.
